messages:
Yvonne (CS): FYI — MediLedger (payments startup) just asked to onboard a model for payments categorization + PII redaction. They need hosted API for US + a Private VPC deploy for EU compliance. They want safety guarantees and an eval plan before we go to Dedicated capacity. Asked for timeline and cost estimate.
MediLedger Tech PM: Thanks Yvonne. Goal: classify transactions into 12 merchant categories, mask PII (card numbers, emails), and output a normalized merchant name. We have ~420k historical labeled transactions (S3: s3://mediledger-prod/onboarding/transactions-420k.csv). Expected peak QPS 60, avg payload ~140 tokens. Need EU data residency.
Raj (Solutions): Got it. A few quick Qs: label schema JSON? sample rows? is the labeled data human-reviewed or heuristics? any protected columns we must never send to hosted logs?
MediLedger Tech PM: Schema: {category_id, merchant_name_raw, amount, timestamp, metadata}. Data is human-reviewed for ~80% of rows, heuristics for old ones. We'll need logs off for EU tenants.
Miguel (Safety): PII redaction + never-leak customer identifiers = highest priority. We'll need: 1) unit tests for redaction (regex+model fallback), 2) adversarial prompt tests (red-team), 3) thresholded confidence gating for merchant normalization. Blocklist of ~250 merchant names flagged for compliance — will provide. Also, add explainability hooks (why a merchant was normalized) for audits.
Clara (Onboarding): Recommend starting with redwood-alpha-7b-int8 (verified profile for classification+NER) on Dedicated in EU region for the Private deploy. For hosted dev/testing we can use redwood-alpha-7b-quant to iterate. Expect p95 latency ~90-150ms for 140-token inputs with batching tuned.
Devon (SE): I'll put together an eval harness. Draft eval plan: 1) accuracy on category labels (macro-F1 target >= 0.92), 2) NER redaction precision >= 0.995 (especially card numbers/emails), 3) normalization correctness (top-1 exact match >= 0.88), 4) safety fail rate <= 0.002 on adversarial suite.
Devon (SE): Eval harness snippet:```python
# simplified
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
results = c.run_batch(model='redwood-alpha-7b-quant', inputs=test_set)
metrics = compute_metrics(results, gold)
print(metrics)
```
Raj (Solutions): For rollout — customer wants a 2-week canary on Dedicated EU with 10% of traffic, then ramp to 100% if no regressions. We should plan for automatic fallback to hosted lower-cost variant if Dedicated capacity hits limit. Thoughts?
Clara (Onboarding): Canary ok. Need capacity reservation request (Dedicated PO) and autoscale policy: min 2 GPUs, burst to 6 for peak. Also add KV caching for repeat merchant normalizations to reduce cost.
Miguel (Safety): Add continuous monitoring: daily safety evals on a rolling prompt set + immediate alerts if fail rate spikes. For PII, require deterministic masking before sending to model unless explicit allowlist.
Yvonne (CS): I'll collect the label schema and the blocklist from the customer today. Also confirm contractual requirement for EU log blackout.
MediLedger Tech PM: I'll share the blocklist and sample CSV by EOD. We also want a short runbook: how to request emergency rollback.
Raj (Solutions): I'll open ENG-ONBOARD ticket and link to SRE/infra for Dedicated capacity. JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-ONBOARD-1142
Clara (Onboarding): Added checklist to the ticket: dataset ingestion, eval harness, safety tests, dedicated capacity, canary config, audit hooks.
Devon (SE): For the eval sets — request 3 splits: train/dev/test (we only need dev/test for evaluation). We'll need ~5k holdout rows for testing normalization and 2k adversarial for red-team.
Miguel (Safety): I'll draft the adversarial templates (social engineering, token-split PII, noisy merchant names). Also add a manual red-team window post-canary.
Yvonne (CS): Can we give MediLedger a rough timeline? Assume we start next week once they upload the samples.
Clara (Onboarding): Rough timeline: week 1 — dataset ingest + small hosted trial; week 2 — eval tuning + safety tests; week 3 — Dedicated deploy + canary; week 5 — ramp to prod if green. So ~4–5 weeks end-to-end.
MediLedger Tech PM: Good — fine with that. Cost ballpark for Dedicated + 6 GPU burst + private control plane? Need estimate to include in contract.
Raj (Solutions): I'll run a cost calc and post numbers in the ticket by tomorrow.
Devon (SE): Putting initial eval harness repo link here: https://git.internal/redwood/onboarding/mediledger-evals (private).
Yvonne (CS): Thanks team. I'll schedule a kickoff call for Monday 10am PT with MediLedger, @Raj (Solutions) and @Miguel (Safety) invited.
Miguel (Safety): On it. Also suggest we add an explicit requirement: no model access to raw PANs even inside Private deploy; only masked tokens allowed in logs/observability.
Clara (Onboarding): Noted. I'll configure log redaction and telemetry scrubbing in the Private deploy template.
eval-bot: Summary: created eval task list (classification accuracy, NER redaction, normalization, adversarial suite). Assigned to Devon. Deadline: initial results in 7 business days. :white_check_mark:
Yvonne (CS): Great — I'll update the customer after the kickoff invite. :thumbsup:
